notes.title: Update 13.356
notes.notes:
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized textures, performance boost which also reduced the game's build size by about half. 
[*] Adjusted maximum light sources to fix flickering. Note that performance may suffer in areas with a high density of lights.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where customers would get stuck in the bar after the hotel closed.
[*] Corrected a bug where second-floor items became non-interactable after a cocktail fell off the map.
[/list]

notes.title: 🚨 New Update – Miami Hotel Simulator! 🚨
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey players![/h3]
 
The latest update is here. Patch notes:

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bartending: Serve cocktails to customers.
[*] Finance App: Track income and expenses with a graph.
[*] Third-Person Mode: Play the game from a new perspective.
[*] Movable Items: Move kitchen items, including the washing machine, food buffet, and plate holder.
[/list]

[h3][b]Performance:[/b]
[/h3][list]
[*] Optimized netcode.
[*] Improved overall performance.
[/list]
[h3][b]Vehicles:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted car specs.
[*] Fixed glitches with player-owned car physics.
[*] Fixed cars sometimes flipping when exiting.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Spanish translation.
[/list]

Update now and enjoy the new features!

notes.title: Update 13.346
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes on reception logic 
[*] Fixed floating room keys caused by staff 
[*] Adjusted bed sizes 
[*] Fixed bed holding pivot 
[*] Optimized staff data synchronization 
[*] Adjusted various lamp's intensity 
[*] Staff will now leave hotel after they finish current task 
[*] Added staff information while looking at target person 
[*] Fixed map not closing on pressing map key 
[*] Added more doors for staff to spawn/despawn 
[*] Fixes for staff tasks while player in pause 
[*] Fixed cruise ship and plane disappearing 
[*] Fixed customers won't lift their keys or money for client 
[*] Fixed room key got is missing in save file 
[*] Optimized far object and map texture 
[*] Fixed chat window hides early 
[*] Fixes for ID zero being sent for client connection causes initialization failures 
[*] Staff now can also pick money from the vending machine 
[*] Added ability to show hovering item on the inventory 
[*] Customer now walks slightly faster (except old lady) 
[*] Added some missing localization 
[*] Main menu scene optimization 
[*] Added ability to skip shader warmup if VRAM is lower than 2GB or via -skipShader
[/list]
